commands.name: lasem-render-0.6
commands.description: Render an SVG or MathML document to PNG/PDF/SVG/PS via the lasem library

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format (png, pdf, svg, ps); default: inferred from output extension

options.name: --width
options.description: Width in pixels of the output

options.name: --height
options.description: Height in pixels of the output
